Question: In connection with proof in geometry, indicate which one of the following statements is incorrect:

Choices.A: Some statements are accepted without being proved.
Choices.B:
In some instances there is more than one correct order in
proving certain propositions.
Choices.C:
Every term used in a proof must have been
defined previously.
Choices.D:
It is not possible to arrive by correct reasoning at a true
conclusion if, in the given, there is an untrue proposition.
Choices.E:
Indirect proof can be used whenever there are two or more
contrary propositions.
